research_scope: Source-free independent Wave2 mathematical prerequisite review; retaining source-specific structure, all parent definitions and citations; no certification or consolidation gate.

aliases.reason: The categorical-limit and colimit source formulas use index category I and target category C, each with objects, arrows, identity and associative composition. They do not stipulate a small target category. This is the size-unrestricted underlying ordinary-category prerequisite, instantiated twice; the diagram functor, cone/cocone and universal properties remain additional parent conditions.

In flat and faithfully flat module definitions, the operation N↦N⊗_R M, with morphism action f↦f⊗id_M, is a covariant functor between the categories of R-modules, preserving identities and composition and with no small-category hypothesis. This uses the same generic functor prerequisite; the tensor-product implementation and (reflection and) preservation of exactness are additional parent-specific requirements.

The projective-module Hom exactness source's covariant Hom_R(P,−) takes an R-module N to Hom_R(P,N) and a morphism g to postcomposition g∘−, preserving identities and compositions. Thus it is a typed instance of unrestricted ordinary functoriality. The choice of Hom construction, additivity, and exactness condition remain attached to the projectivity source, and no restriction to small categories is imported.
